verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs say it implements two multi-party agentic protocols, ACP and UCP. They also name independent platforms it works with: OpenAI, Meta, Google (Gemini / AI Mode), ChatGPT and Copilot. That suggests an ecosystem rather than a private integration, but all of it comes from vendor claims. Nothing documents which parties independently implement ACP or UCP themselves. Missing for 10: independent evidence that at least two non-Adyen parties implement the protocols, protocol spec or governance documentation, third-party corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, at least two independent parties beyond the vendor implement the protocol or platform — it is an ecosystem, not a private integration
